integrity: The source mean-field flow and Bloch matrix are prior art. The new contribution is the exact finite-ring all-mode stability boundary, five-site minimum, optimal activity and finite-size correction. Independent mathematical and priority audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Linear mean-field classification on one-dimensional periodic rings, not nonlinear equilibrium selection or the exact finite stochastic particle chain; no higher-dimensional or nonperiodic statement.
title: Exact finite-ring spinodal and a five-site instability cutoff for a one-dimensional active lattice gas
